ValidationRule.description: Dock time must be in 07:00-18:59, not a lunch slot at 12:xx on the half hour, and the datetime-to-time check on ETA must not land on the dock-closed 00:00 sentinel.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Dock_Time__c)), OR( HOUR(Dock_Time__c) < 7, HOUR(Dock_Time__c) > 18, AND(HOUR(Dock_Time__c) = 12, MINUTE(Dock_Time__c) = 30), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Estimated_Arrival__c)), TIMEVALUE(Estimated_Arrival__c) = TIMEVALUE('00:00:00.000'), MILLISECOND(Dock_Time__c) <> 0) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Dock Time is outside the allowed window.
